pages.text: $(thing)Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks$() adds spellcasting. You carry a spell book, fill its slots with spells, and cast them using mana. Spells belong to schools, and gear raises the power of one school or all.

pages.title: Scroll
pages.text: A single-use spell. Anyone can cast one, no book needed. Spells are made or found at several tiers of rarity.

pages.title: Spell Books
pages.text: Books run from Flimsy Journal (copper) up to Ancient Codex (netherite). Better books hold more spell slots.

pages.title: Scroll Forge
pages.text: Where scrolls are made. Built from polished deepslate and crying obsidian.

pages.title: Inscription Table
pages.text: Where spells are written into a spell book.

Magic crafting uses ink in five rarities, Arcane Essence, Mithril, Pyrium and Arcane Ingots, plus Upgrade Orbs that boost a school. An $(item)Alchemist Cauldron$(), Arcane Anvil and Pedestals help. Rings and necklaces are worn in $(l:exploration/gear)Curios slots$(/l).

Create hooks in directly. Inks, Blood Vials, Timeless Slurry and several elixirs have Create filling and emptying recipes, so a Spout can fill them from fluid and a Drain can empty them. See $(l:create_basics/fluids)Fluids$(/l).

The world has wizard towers and a lost Citadel: Pyromancer Tower, Archevoker's Evoker Fort, Ice Spider Den, Ancient Battleground, Catacombs, and the Citadel (a Citadel Map exists). Mage mobs defend them. Pack-wide bosses: $(l:exploration/bosses)Bosses$(/l).

pages.title: Turned off here
pages.text: Three spells would replace vehicles, so they never show up in loot, the Scroll Forge or JEI: $(bold)Portal$() (permanent two-way links), $(bold)Recall$() (home from anywhere) and $(bold)Angel Wings$() (Elytra flight). Portal Frames and the Hither-Thither Wand can't be crafted. See $(l:transport/getting_around)Getting Around$(/l).
